association_evidence: Zenodo record description states the deposit includes four plots (resistance, capacitance, real and imaginary impedance) and CSV files from the same fish spoilage sensor measurement.
description_html:
This data represents a measurement conducted using an impedance analyzer connected to our spoilage sensor, which was described in detail in our previously published paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s43016-023-00750-9

The data includes four plots: resistance, capacitance, real and imaginary impedance

Data includes measurements from a fish piece in a petri dish placed next to our food spoil sensor. As the fish piece gets spoiled, impedance changes.
title: Electrical impedance of food sensor recorded during fish spoilage
